title: Optional coaching questionnaire

flow.note: Closing a browser tab may lose the draft. No server-side answer draft is part of this default.

copy.card_description: An optional questionnaire to help me prepare for our conversation. There are 45 questions, and every question can be skipped. Allow around 25–35 minutes if you choose to answer them all.
copy.intro: There are no right or wrong answers. Share only what you feel comfortable sharing. You can skip any question or return to booking whenever you like.
copy.draft_notice: Your progress is kept in this tab during booking. It may be lost if you close the tab. Answers are sent to Aarkesh when you confirm your booking.
copy.finish_message: Thank you for sharing what feels useful. You can review your answers or return to booking.
copy.selection_limit_error: Choose up to {max} options. Deselect one to choose another.
copy.privacy_policy_note: Connect to the current published policy before launch; do not ship a placeholder URL.

response_contract.opened: Boolean; true once the questionnaire was opened, including if no answers were given

response_fields.selected_option_ids: Array of option IDs, empty for a text question
response_fields.text: String or null; only for a text question
response_fields.other_text_by_option_id: Object mapping selected write-in option IDs to optional text

rules: Not sure, Not applicable and Prefer not to say are answered states with their actual option IDs.
A selected confidence value of 0 is an answer; never treat it as empty.
Unanswered and skipped responses have no selected options, text or write-ins.
Trim text for blank detection; do not require a minimum number of characters.
Keep question and option IDs stable; retain the content version with every saved response.
